description: This source file defines functions and classes related to protocol types and message handling within the confui namespace of the cuttlefish project. It includes conversion functions for command enums, string representations, and message serialization methods for various protocol messages used in the confui communication protocol.

classes.name: ConfUiMessage
classes.description: Base class or struct representing a generic confui message, providing methods like IsUserInput().

classes.name: ConfUiAckMessage
classes.description: Represents an acknowledgment message in the protocol, with methods to convert to string and send over a file descriptor.

classes.name: ConfUiCliResponseMessage
classes.description: Represents a CLI response message, with string serialization and transmission methods.

classes.name: ConfUiStartMessage
classes.description: Represents a start message with UI options, including methods for string conversion and sending.

classes.name: ConfUiUserSelectionMessage
classes.description: Represents a user selection message with string conversion and sending capabilities.

classes.name: ConfUiUserTouchMessage
classes.description: Represents a user touch message, encapsulating position data, with methods for string conversion and transmitting.

methods.name: std::string ToDebugString(const ConfUiCmd & cmd,const bool is_verbose)
methods.description: Creates a verbose debug string representation of a ConfUiCmd, optionally including extras.

methods.name: std::string ToString() const
methods.description: Returns a simple string representation of a ConfUiCmd.

methods.name: ConfUiCmd ToCmd(const std::string & cmd_str)
methods.description: Converts a uint32_t or string to a ConfUiCmd enumeration value.

methods.name: std::optional<teeui::UIOption> ToUiOption(const std::string & src)
methods.description: Converts a string to an optional UIOption, if the string contains only digits.

methods.name: std::string ByteVecToString(const std::vector<T> & v)
methods.description: Converts a vector of bytes/t elements into a string.

methods.name: ConfUiMessage::IsUserInput
methods.description: Determines if the message type is a user input event.

methods.name: ConfUiAckMessage::ToString
methods.description: Serializes an acknowledgment message into a string.

methods.name: ConfUiAckMessage::SendOver
methods.description: Sends the acknowledgment message over a file descriptor.

methods.name: ConfUiCliResponseMessage::ToString
methods.description: Serializes a CLI response message into a string.

methods.name: ConfUiCliResponseMessage::SendOver
methods.description: Sends the CLI response message over a file descriptor.

methods.name: ConfUiStartMessage::UiOptsToString
methods.description: Converts the UI options vector into a comma-separated string.

methods.name: ConfUiStartMessage::ToString
methods.description: Serializes a start message with included UI options into a string.

methods.name: ConfUiStartMessage::SendOver
methods.description: Sends the start message over a file descriptor.

methods.name: ConfUiUserSelectionMessage::ToString
methods.description: Serializes a user selection message into a string.

methods.name: ConfUiUserSelectionMessage::SendOver
methods.description: Sends the user selection message over a file descriptor.

methods.name: ConfUiUserTouchMessage::ToString
methods.description: Serializes a user touch message, including position data, into a string.

methods.name: ConfUiUserTouchMessage::SendOver
methods.description: Sends the user touch message over a file descriptor.
